title: rubus podophyllos var. belonostachys
intro: Rubus podophyllos var. belonostachys, commonly known as Himalayan Raspberry, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan Raspberry include wound healing, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's ability to modulate various physiological processes and provide relief from various health conditions.
